brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Studying the principal gradients of cortical functional organisation.

**Not for:** Comparing subjects without aligning gradients (sign and order can flip).

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.surface.gradient.json
